forecasts.derivation: Account S1/S6 (an edit holding RL's own pairs at 1.25-1.5x lands near RL per sample): the m=64 restriction keeps 0.76/0.78 of the top-8 edit (result-ce52f8), so after norm matching it carries ~1.3x of the true pairs, which puts it between the 1x edit (192, result-284db5) and the 1.5x edit (203, result-306787), a little below RL's 206.

Account S1 (only RL's exact pairs act; shifted or random pairs stay at the base, 158-163 in result-0d54f3): at m=8 only 0.40/0.42 of the edit survives (result-ce52f8), so norm matching gives ~0.95x of the true pairs plus a larger shared-subspace distortion, which should fall short of the 1x edit's 192 and the 1-direction edit's 181, while staying above the base's 164.

Account S5 (the vote gains on hard328 only through scattered wrong answers, and most misses have no right sample, so about 9 points stay out of inference reach): the stored curve 159.5/188.5/197 at k=1/4/6 (result-c065a6) extrapolates log-linearly to 202 at k=8, trimmed for saturation because 107 of 131 wrong problems have no right sample among 6.

Account S5 saturation applied to result-c065a6: vote over 4 is 188.5 and the log-linear step of ~14 per doubling of k (29 over k=1 to 4, 8.5 over k=4 to 6) is shrunk by the base having no right sample on most missed problems (knowledge-b19faf: 7 % per-sample rate on 0-of-4 problems), giving about +11.5.
